Each Maestria plugin has its own contributing guide with project structure, source file locations, and build commands. Developer documentation is at the repository root.

## Canonical Source Workflow

Agent prompts, specialist personas, and global rules are authored in a single canonical source at `packages/core/agent-directives/` and synced to all plugin packages via the config-driven sync pipeline.

**Never edit the generated files** in plugin-specific directories (`packages/opencode/agents/`, `packages/pi/agents/`, `packages/pi/skills/`, `packages/kimi-code/skills/`, `packages/cursor/agents/`, `packages/cursor/skills/`, `packages/claude-code/agents/`, `packages/claude-code/skills/`, `packages/claude-code/commands/`, `packages/codex/skills/`, `packages/agent-plugin/skills/`, or any `rules/` directory) - they are overwritten on every sync.

### Editing the Canonical Source

To modify an agent prompt or global rule:

1. Edit the corresponding file in `packages/core/agent-directives/specialists/` (e.g., `builder.md` for the Builder specialist) or `packages/core/agent-directives/rules.md` for global rules
2. Run `scripts/sync-all` from the repo root to regenerate all plugin-specific files
3. Verify with `scripts/check-sync` (also run as part of `vp check`)

The canonical source is plain Markdown without platform-specific syntax, YAML frontmatter, or role prefixes (`@`). Platform adaptations are handled by the sync pipeline's transforms.

### How the Sync Pipeline Works

Each plugin has a `sync.config.ts` that defines how canonical content is adapted:

| Plugin | Config | Transforms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@maestria/opencode` | `packages/opencode/sync.config.ts` | Adds YAML frontmatter with permissions per specialist |
| `@maestria/kimi-code` | `packages/kimi-code/sync.config.ts` | Converts to SKILL.md format with a set of text replacements adapting tool names and platform vocabulary, persona prepends, and routing table |
| `@maestria/pi` | `packages/pi/sync.config.ts` | Text replacements adapting role prefixes and delegation calls (`@adventurer` → `/adventurer`, `task()` → `maestria_subagent()`) |
| `@maestria/omp` | `packages/omp/sync.config.ts` | Keeps OMP's native `task()` dispatch and adapts role references for generated agents and skills |
| `@maestria/cursor` | `packages/cursor/sync.config.ts` | Adapts role references, tool names, `Task` dispatch, and read-only frontmatter |
| `@maestria/claude-code` | `packages/claude-code/sync.config.ts` | Namespaced agents and skills, Claude tool names, and read-only `disallowedTools` fields |
| `@maestria/codex` | `packages/codex/sync.config.ts` | Namespaced skills, workflow modes as skills, and advisory role boundaries |
| `@maestria/hermes` | `packages/hermes/sync.config.ts` | Adapts tool names and role references for Hermes skills and its general-purpose runtime |
| `@maestria/prime-agent` | `packages/prime-agent/sync.config.ts` | Emits Agent Skills frontmatter, plain role references, and advisory read-only notes |
| `@maestria/agent-plugin` | `packages/agent-plugin/sync.config.ts` | Agent Plugins v1 fixed `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` layout, plain role names, and advisory portable boundaries |

### Running the Docs Site

```bash
vp run @maestria/docs#dev
```

This starts the Astro dev server for the user-facing documentation at `apps/docs/`.
